_about: The pets' voices (12 Nov 2026, Jon: "Can we get voices reading for the pets", then "I need better voices. not robotic at all.", then his casting: "young voices like kids Male for irwin, female for granola. Sexy/sassy voice for Boo. rough man voice for salem. Old man voice for zimmy. Make them natural. Make them MP3 files"). For each pet: which natural voice reads it, its pace (1 is the voice's own; 1.1 a little faster, 0.9 a little slower) and its pitch (1 is the voice's own; above 1 is younger and smaller, about 1.2 for a child; below 1 is bigger and deeper), and, only where wanted, lower (how far the voice's note is brought down afterwards with its size kept: 1 or left out is not at all, 0.7 is about six notes down; this is how a voice can be low but like a child), and accent (aussie or aussie-light: an accent the model has no voice for; each word is read the British way and its vowels moved the Australian way). The voices belong to the voice model that is already on this Mac (Kokoro, through mlx-audio): free, nothing downloaded, nothing leaves the Mac. npm run pet-voices makes an MP3 for every line a pet can say, silently, into pet-voices/ (kept off the site until Jon says yes). To change a pet's voice, change it here and run it again: that pet's files are made again. saidAs: a few words spelled the way they sound, for the voice only (all: every voice; american and british: only voices of that accent, whose names start with a or b); the card's words never change. goOut: Jon's answer to whether the voices go out on the site: none (until he says yes), irwin (Sir Irwin only) or all. A test holds the site's folder to it.

Or French American" and "10 boo - 1", last: "Boo needs to be 8 Boo - 1 the French one" (the French woman's voice, her lines as written, slow). Sir Irwin, after "a dum-dum voice ... Forget the low and slow." and "12 Irwin - 5": a British boy's voice at a boy's pitch with the lighter Australian accent.
